description: This file defines an ErrorBoundary component for a Blits-based frontend application. It captures rendering errors within child components and displays an error message overlay, preventing the UI from becoming blank due to unhandled errors.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the error state to clear any existing error information.

methods.name: _renderChildrenSafe
methods.description: Attempts to render child content safely; catches and handles errors thrown during rendering.
